comparison.objective: Route a connected cable between posts and latch it into a final clip while preserving an existing fixing; candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests articulated-cable routing, bimanual contact, alignment into spring-loaded clip jaws, seating and release. Candidate tests rigid small-tool insertion, counterholding, controlled collar rotation, force-limited locking and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires correct routing, both clips seated, both arms contacting the wire for at least 0.2 s each, release, clearance, low wire speed and a 2 s hold; upstream release or wire separation is fatal. Candidate requires two repeatable safe carriage stops and post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: Cable routing and clip latching test deformable/articulated path control and retention, unlike rigid damper adjustment and impact commissioning. No spec versions are indexed for this record, so full setup geometry and some numeric routing/clip predicates are missing, but the body gives enough objective, manipulation and scoring evidence to establish a meaningful distinction.
